bounds: Three URL/credential hashes, capacity two, four calls and two expiry epochs. Capacity models the same FIFO replacement used at 256 entries. Network completion is abstract; no elapsed-time or provider-success guarantee.
limitations: Identity hashes are assumed distinct. No raw credentials are modeled or returned.
The server reuses canonical generative authentication and admission snapshot publication. This cache model does not replace their authorization or billing models.

The actual client tests exercise debounce, credential changes, skipped requests and failures. The server-shell tests cover anonymous and body-bearing refusals. Live latency and billing non-mutation remain separate rollout checks.

assumptions: Weak fairness of each pending fetch completion. Completion includes failure, timeout and cancellation; no successful warmup is assumed.
